answer.reason: The verses tell of Ziba's deeds: he told David of Mephibosheth, brought provisions to the fleeing David, and was given part of the land.

clauses.english: told David of Jonathan's lame son Mephibosheth, and was set to till his land
clauses.quote: Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.

clauses.english: met the fleeing David with asses, bread and wine, and was given all that had been Mephibosheth's
clauses.quote: Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth.

clauses.english: was told by David to divide the land with Mephibosheth
clauses.quote: Thou and Ziba divide the land.

doubts: The first clause joins two things (telling of Mephibosheth, being set to till his land); the editor may wish to trim it to one.
The slander of Mephibosheth is mentioned only in 2SA 19:27, which is not a marked verse, so it is not stated as Ziba's deed.
